preconditions.detail: SAR-propensity arm beats nnPU on pooled HOLDOUT-DTI and does not lose in the highest-propensity tercile.
All-finite float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, values in [0,1], positive support only outside the mapped catalogue.

No registry raster exceeds rho 0.90 (worst 0.0401), the dot-set Jaccard against every checked raster is at most 0.0207, and all 58 literal 3 px firings are at or below their own uniform null. Flagged as irregularity IR-65-01.

preconditions.detail: 74351 dots, accept candidates in descending expected credit with non-maximum suppression at the metric's 3 px kernel radius, budget taken to saturation on the measured curve, then prune every dot within 2.0 px of a mapped fault.
